name: task-9
_ambiguities: Contents items are assumed to be listed in the same top-to-bottom order as the questions, so item 10 is the sample question at the bottom and item 1 is the top question.
Contents items are assumed to be the only children of the .contents panel (nth-child used).
The fixed position at the right side is a CSS property and is not checked; only visibility and that interactive elements are not covered are checked.
Item text equal to each question title is not checked (titles are random), except the sample question's count via the 10 items.
Class API of Contents.js is not observable; only its module request is checked.
